text.p: These are the leading stories in Zambia's newspapers on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A UNICEF report recommended that Zambia cuts its dependance on donor aid, which has too many strings attached to it for the successful implementation of investment programmes.
- Some 700 more Zaireans fleeing the civil war in their country crossed the border into Zambia.
- A witness in an opposition electoral petition claims ruling MMD party officials helped obtain duplicate cards to vote twice in general elections held last November.
- Copperbelt University students continued with a class boycott to push for delayed book allowances.
